name: Pirate Weather API
summary: Dark Sky-compatible weather forecast API built on open NOAA and ECMWF model data, with a free 10,000-call monthly tier.
description: Returns current conditions, minutely, hourly (48 hours, or 168 with extend=hourly) and daily forecasts, alerts and optional historical (timemachine) data for a latitude and longitude, in the response shape of the retired Dark Sky API. Includes a lang parameter for translated summaries and several unit systems. A free key is required and must be subscribed after sign-up.

auth.notes: Request a key at pirateweather.net, then subscribe to the forecast API in the account; the docs say the key can take up to 20 minutes to activate.

rate_limit.summary: The homepage advertises 10,000 free calls per month; the docs say a small donation raises it to 20,000. Responses expose ratelimit-limit, ratelimit-remaining and ratelimit-reset headers via CORS.

endpoints.summary: Current, minutely, hourly and daily forecast for a point
Forecast or observed data for a Unix or ISO time

license.name: Not stated in the docs fetched; model data from NOAA, ECMWF and others

coverage.temporal: Forecast up to 7-10 days plus historical timemachine

agent_notes: The API key sits in the URL path. Without a valid key the API answers HTTP 401 with {"message":"Unauthorized"}. Per the docs, the response mirrors Dark Sky: currently, minutely, hourly, daily, alerts blocks; use exclude=minutely,alerts to shrink it and units=si for metric. Locations can also be given as city,country.
caveats: Only the unauthenticated 401 response was observed here; the endpoint, parameters and limits come from the public docs and homepage, not from a keyed call.
The free tier needs sign-up and a subscribe step; whether a credit card is needed was not checked.
Run by a single maintainer funded by donations; the docs ask for support.

verification.notes: Example is the unauthenticated request with a dummy key; 401 observed, no key was available to this run.

hn.title: Pirate Weather: A free, open, and documented forecast API
